verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists a "Bring your own keys" row that is enabled only on higher tiers, which suggests developers can supply their own LLM provider keys. However, the evidence never says which providers or models are supported, or that Notte's agent framework is model-agnostic. The OpenAI CUA and MCP/CrewAI/Vercel integrations are external agents driving Notte browsers, an adjacent capability, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of supported LLM providers/models, configuration docs for swapping models in the agent SDK, BYOK on lower tiers, independent corroboration.
